# laravelforge_webhook (Resource)

Manages a deployment webhook on a Laravel Forge site. Forge has no update endpoint for webhooks, so any change to `url` replaces the resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the server the site belongs to.
- `site_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the site to attach the webhook to.
- `url` (String) URL the webhook posts to on deployment. Create-only; changing it replaces the webhook.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the webhook.
